Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair one tiny broken brown grout line in this native 1254 by 1254 hand-painted game floor.
Image 1 is the exact original map crop. Image 2 marks the required connector in cyan and the two fixed endpoints in magenta, near the CENTER of the image.
There are two separate existing brown diagonal grout strokes. The lower-left stroke ends at (627,574). The upper-right stroke begins at (627,631). Keep BOTH exact existing strokes and endpoints untouched. ADD ONLY one straight VERTICAL brown recessed grout segment from (627,574) DOWN to (627,631), about 3 pixels wide, with a subtle matching pale bevel. Turn the CYAN segment into brown grout. It creates a small deliberate stepped connection. Do not make the existing diagonals meet by shifting, lengthening, deleting, or redrawing them. Do not introduce any new gold node or diagonal spur.
Preserve all existing brown lines and gold vertices pixel-for-pixel outside x=615..639,y=562..643. Keep all surrounding stone textures and the same grid. Remove every cyan/magenta mark. No global regularization, no added stones, no crop, zoom, resize or reframing. Exact opaque native RGB 1254 x 1254 output.
